The reply in your screenshot now renders correctly. A ```` ``` ```` in the middle of a sentence stays prose. All tests pass: 798 in `src`, 27 of them in `src/md.test.ts`.

The cause was in the renderer. It treated every ```` ``` ```` as a fence, even inside a sentence. My reply had ```` ```ts title=x ```` in an inline code span, so the text after it became one large code block.

The fix follows CommonMark, the standard Markdown specification:

1. **Fences:** a fence opens and closes only on a line of its own. The closing line must have at least as many backticks as the opening line, so a fence can hold a shorter fence.
2. **Inline code:** a code span can use two or more backticks as its delimiter. Then it can hold a backtick, for example ```` ```ts ```` or ``` `` a`b `` ```.

These are normal Markdown rules, so I did not add a card. The server runs with `--hot`, so the map shows the fix without a restart.
